meta.title: Use async generators for GitLab getGroups() method to improve memory efficiency
meta.body_summary: Convert GitLab getGroups() to async generator to stream groups instead of collecting in memory, improving memory efficiency for large GitLab instances.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot converted getGroups to async generator; maintainer closed due to branch mismatch, no performance review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 72 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small refactor. As a small-step performance optimization it was closed—not merged—because the maintainer redirected the work to a different branch.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer ypc-faros instructed Copilot to use the `copilot-replay-pr2101` branch; Copilot claimed to have switched but PR was closed anyway.
review_details.performance_claim: Memory efficiency and streaming via async generator instead of array collection.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed because PR was created on wrong branch despite prior instructions.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot commits changes on default branch despite maintainer direction to use a specific replay branch, leading to closure.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer ypc-faros observed the PR was created on the wrong branch rather than copilot-replay-pr2101, as previously instructed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or numeric performance evidence; only narrative claim of memory saving.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix attempted because the issue was branch compliance, not code quality.

core_change_summary.description: Converted getGroups() in gitlab.ts from returning Promise<FarosGroupOutput[]> to AsyncGenerator<FarosGroupOutput> by directly yielding converted groups instead of building an array; removed @Memoize(); updated getOrgs() and onBeforeRead() consumers to use for await...of; updated tests to mock async generator.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files updated to match the async generator signature (createAsyncGeneratorMock helper).
change_trajectory: Main commit: convert getGroups to async generator, update consumers, update tests.
